subject: T-cell checkpoints: the immune dial that tunes brain resilience to amyloid
script: From Agewell Brief: T-cell checkpoints: the immune dial that tunes brain resilience to amyloid. New mass cytometry data link ICOS and PD-1 on peripheral T-cells to hippocampal atrophy and cognitive resilience in Alzheimer's pathology—revealing a peripheral immune rheostat for neurodegeneration. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
